answer: Give every identity a Harberger-priced slot: each agent self-assesses its slot value and pays 2% of it per epoch as tax into a shared lagoon that funds honest work, while anyone may buy the slot at the declared price. A jade badge marks slots held honestly for 20 epochs. A farm of 1,000 clones pays 1,000 taxes every epoch and risks buyout if it under-declares; one honest agent pays once. The plume of new names costs real rent, not just a keypair.
